input.quote: 14.5 Limitation of Liability. NEITHER PARTY SHALL BE LIABLE TO THE OTHER FOR ANY SPECIAL, CONSEQUENTIAL, INCIDENTAL, PUNITIVE, OR INDIRECT DAMAGES OR LOST PROFITS ARISING FROM OR RELATING TO ANY BREACH OF THIS AGREEMENT, REGARDLESS OF ANY NOTICE OF THE POSSIBILITY OF SUCH DAMAGES.
input.rationale: Section 14.5 is the only limitation-of-liability provision in the Agreement (searches for "aggregate liability" and other cap language return nothing else, and Section 14.6 expressly says insurance does not create a liability limit). It is mutual and waives indirect/consequential damages and lost profits, and it preserves the indemnities under Sections 14.1-14.2, confidentiality (Article XI) and IP (Article X) outside that waiver — all consistent with the playbook's carve-out expectations. However, there is no monetary cap of any kind: both Parties' direct-damages exposure is unlimited. That fails the fallback, which requires a mutual cap of at least twelve months' fees. As the paying party facing uncapped direct-damages claims (for example for alleged breach of diligence or of Article XIV obligations), a mutual cap is materially in our interest. Redline inserts a mutual cap at the greater of twelve months' payments and USD 1,000,000, keeps the existing indemnity/confidentiality/IP carve-outs plus gross negligence, willful misconduct and fraud outside the cap, and confirms Sanofi's payment obligations are not "damages" for cap purposes.

proposal.summary: Add a mutual aggregate liability cap to Section 14.5, with indemnification, confidentiality, IP, gross negligence/willful misconduct/fraud and Sanofi's payment obligations outside the cap.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 14.5 waives consequential damages but leaves both Parties' aggregate liability entirely uncapped; our position is a mutual cap at the greater of twelve months' payments and USD 1,000,000. Indemnification, confidentiality, IP infringement, gross negligence/willful misconduct/fraud and Sanofi's payment obligations remain outside the cap, so the existing carve-outs in Section 14.5 are preserved.

ops.text: Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of (a) the amounts paid or payable by Sanofi to RevMed under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months immediately preceding the event giving rise to the claim and (b) USD 1,000,000. "Excluded Claims" means a Party's indemnification obligations under Section 14.1 or Section 14.2, a Party's breach of its confidentiality obligations under Article XI, a Party's infringement or misappropriation of the other Party's intellectual property rights (including any breach of Article X), and a Party's gross negligence, willful misconduct or fraud. For clarity, Sanofi's obligations to make payments due under this Agreement shall not be treated as damages subject to the foregoing cap.
